cases.ownerNote: Consider only compute_consensus and detect_outliers_iqr for reuse; exclude every other target.
reviewPoints: Both functions depend on Polars; compute_consensus also uses NumPy.
Pearson joins common keys; fewer than two matches and NaN correlation return 0. Duplicate keys and constant scores are not validated.
IQR flags scores strictly outside computed bounds; no claim of validated scientific correctness or passing tests.
